blockers.requirement: Boundary guard must reject report/input collision without changing the supplied artifact.
blockers.static_contradiction: out is assigned before need(out!==input). On exact equality need throws report_input_collision, catch records failure, but the unconditional if(out) write then overwrites that SAME input with report JSON. This occurs before loadApp, without requiring any valid APP or hypothetical protocol data.
blockers.requested_fix: Do not set a writable report target until collision validation succeeds, or gate the final write on successful collision validation. Add a NEW sentinel-file CLI test proving collision rejection preserves input bytes; do not alter old gates. Also consider existing-file/symlink alias collisions.
blockers.reproduction: Not executed: static control flow is sufficient and avoids deliberately overwriting any input.

nonblocking_observations.finding: safe_rows is attached to report before numeric-msg validation. If validation fails, catch still writes the attached invalid rows. Current product app.js:17-36 and wearTrace.js:26-36 sanitize fixed numeric fields, so no current-source secret leak was demonstrated. This is a fail-path hardening concern, not an invented malformed-APP blocker.
nonblocking_observations.suggestion: Validate rows in a local value before publishing them to report; preferably retain the exact product field whitelist rather than arbitrary numeric key names. Never serialize rejected msg text.

nonblocking_observations.finding: HOST callbacks preserve complete/success/fail signatures and numeric zero. However unsubscribe count includes the versioned pre-registration unsubscribe and compat close, so listener_closed=unsubscribes>0 is not independently a page-close listener proof. Stage presence also combines versioned and compat runs; compat send remains on injected fail mode.
nonblocking_observations.suggestion: On real APP execution, identify per-path stage rows/callback results and per-close subscription deltas; do not promote aggregate booleans to full native/listener acceptance.
